components.label: api
responsibilities: Expose the typed facade and lazily compose workspace-bound CE adapters through bootstrap.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own compilation, verification, or transport behavior.

requires.rationale: Only bootstrap constructs CE workspace, catalog, codec, validator, policy and executor adapters.
Static contract composition projects explicitly supplied registry facts.
Composition satisfies the named typed adapter ports.

components.label: domain
responsibilities: Own canonical transport values, complete capture contracts and pure acceptance, completeness, smoke and replay verdicts.

components.label: projection
responsibilities: Build typed authoring-reference variants from canonical intent facts.
forbidden_responsibilities: Define a second DSL catalog or execute a run.

requires.rationale: Projections render authoring-owned facts and types.

components.label: adapters
responsibilities: Own registry-backed codec/catalog, in-memory parser validation, workspace containment, CE bounded execution and resource cleanup.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own intent or duplicate executable DSL definitions.

requires.rationale: Adapters consume typed intent and diagnostics.
Reference responses render canonical authoring-intent projections.
CE adapters implement the application contracts.

components.label: application
responsibilities: Coordinate compile/decompile/build and discovery through typed ports; acceptance and optional smoke share the first complete capture, requested replay uses one second capture.
forbidden_responsibilities: Define new grammar facts or directly execute Runtime internals.

requires.rationale: Workflows operate on typed authoring requests and results.
Use cases invoke injected catalog, codec, validator, bounded policy and executor contracts.

components.label: ports
responsibilities: Declare Codec, Catalog, Validator, BoundedPolicy and Executor protocols over Authoring-owned values.
forbidden_responsibilities: Import concrete adapters, open resources or construct Runtime state.

requires.rationale: Port inputs and results use pure document, request, diagnostic and evidence DTOs.

rules.rationale: Pure intent and rules must not depend on file or execution adapters.

Responsibility layers must not require one another in both directions.
